brief: a world model (`world_model.py`, function predict) that rolls out 20 future 5x5 egocentric frames of a gridworld from 10 context frames and the future actions; loss = 1 - fraction of exactly correct frames on 200 held-out episodes. The record to beat (a stand-in for closed Genie 3) is loss 0.6402; training episodes are in data/train.jsonl and env.py must not be imported
